theorems.name: Submission.dohr_vel_graph_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n), DifferentiableAt ℝ u x → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Rn n => graphPoint z (u z)) x ∧ ∀ v : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fun z : Rn n => graphPoint z (u z)) x v = graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ u x v)
